content.text: {"comps":[{"label":"C1","good":false,"reason":"Makes asphalt, aggregate and mining equipment for road builders and quarries, not oilfield well equipment or services."},{"label":"C2","good":true,"reason":"Makes wellheads and pressure control equipment and runs well-site crews for oil and gas producers, matching the target's well-control business."},{"label":"C3","good":true,"reason":"Provides reservoir services, perforating systems and well completion and production optimization to oil and gas operators, overlapping the target's offering."},{"label":"C4","good":true,"reason":"Rents and sells downhole drilling tools to operators and drillers, matching the target's drilling tools and rental model."},{"label":"C5","good":false,"reason":"Distributes general industrial MRO products and repairs pumps for plants across many industries, not well services for oil producers."},{"label":"C6","good":false,"reason":"Makes welding and cutting consumables and equipment for fabricators and builders, a manufacturing business unrelated to well services."},{"label":"C7","good":false,"reason":"Distributes plumbing, HVAC and waterworks products to contractors and municipalities, serving construction rather than oil and gas wells."},{"label":"C8","good":true,"reason":"Supplies well completion and production chemicals with on-site field services to oil and gas operators, overlapping the target's completion and production work."},{"label":"C9","good":false,"reason":"Makes pumps, valves and seals for industrial plants across many process industries, not downhole or well-site equipment and services."}]}
